Verify Now Blog > Meet PCBWay at EPTECH 2026 in Calgary, Canada Meet PCBWay at EPTECH 2026 in Calgary, Canada by: Mila Oct 16,2026 <dynamic-value> <dynamic-value> Posted in News PCBWay is pleased to announce our participation in EPTECH 2026 – Calgary, part of Canada's national electronics trade show series. Join us on October 27, 2026, at the Best Western Premier Calgary Plaza Hotel & Conference Centre to connect with our team and explore manufacturing solutions for your electronic projects. Visit PCBWay at EPTECH Calgary 2026 Event: EPTECH 2026 – Calgary Date: October 27, 2026 Location: Best Western Premier Calgary Plaza Hotel & Conference Centre, Calgary, Canada PCBWay Booth: To be announced Stop by our booth to meet the PCBWay team, discuss your project requirements, and learn how our services can support your next development or manufacturing project. From Electronic Design to Product Manufacturing Turning an idea into a finished product often involves multiple stages, from circuit development and prototyping to mechanical fabrication and final assembly. PCBWay helps customers manage these steps with a broad range of engineering and manufacturing capabilities. Our PCB Design Service supports projects from schematic design and PCB layout to electronic product development. For customers who already have design files, we provide PCB fabrication and assembly services to help bring their designs to life. Beyond electronics, PCBWay also offers CNC machining, sheet metal fabrication, 3D printing, and injection molding. These services help customers develop custom enclosures, mechanical components, and functional prototypes, making it easier to coordinate different manufacturing needs throughout product development. Whether you are testing an early concept, improving an existing design, or preparing for production, PCBWay can support your project with flexible manufacturing options. EPTECH brings together electronics industry professionals, suppliers, and innovators, creating opportunities to exchange ideas and build new connections. If you are attending EPTECH 2026 in Calgary, we look forward to meeting you and discussing how PCBWay can help turn your ideas into reality. See you in Calgary!
